description: Source code for Bluetooth BR/EDR (Basic Rate / Enhanced Data Rate) handling in Zephyr OS, including connection management, inquiry, security, and feature negotiation.

methods.name: reject_conn
methods.description: Rejects an incoming connection request with a specified reason.

methods.name: accept_sco_conn
methods.description: Accepts an incoming SCO (audio) connection request.

methods.name: accept_conn
methods.description: Accepts an incoming BR/EDR connection request.

methods.name: bt_esco_conn_req
methods.description: Handles an eSCO connection request event.

methods.name: bt_hci_conn_req
methods.description: Handles a connection request event, initiating connection procedures.

methods.name: br_sufficient_key_size
methods.description: Checks if the encryption key size is sufficient for a given connection.

methods.name: bt_br_update_sec_level
methods.description: Updates the security level of a BR/EDR connection based on link key and encryption status.

methods.name: bt_hci_synchronous_conn_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of a synchronous (SCO/eSCO) connection event.

methods.name: bt_hci_conn_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of a BR/EDR connection event.

methods.name: request_name
methods.description: Requests remote device name via HCI command.

methods.name: eir_has_name
methods.description: Checks if Extended Inquiry Response (EIR) data contains a device name.

methods.name: bt_br_discovery_reset
methods.description: Resets discovery result buffers and callback.

methods.name: report_discovery_results
methods.description: Processes and reports discovered Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: get_result_slot
methods.description: Retrieves or allocates a slot for a discovered device based on address and RSSI.

methods.name: bt_hci_inquiry_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of an inquiry process.

methods.name: bt_hci_inquiry_result_with_rssi
methods.description: Processes inquiry results with RSSI data.

methods.name: bt_hci_extended_inquiry_result
methods.description: Processes extended inquiry results.

methods.name: bt_hci_remote_name_request_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of remote name request.

methods.name: bt_hci_read_remote_features_complete
methods.description: Handles remote features read completion.

methods.name: bt_hci_read_remote_ext_features_complete
methods.description: Handles remote extended features read completion.

methods.name: bt_hci_role_change
methods.description: Handles role change events for a connection.

methods.name: read_ext_features
methods.description: Reads local extended features from the controller.

methods.name: device_supported_pkt_type
methods.description: Configures supported packet types based on device features.

methods.name: read_buffer_size_complete
methods.description: Processes buffer size read response.

methods.name: bt_br_init
methods.description: Initializes BR/EDR subsystem, including features, buffer sizes, and settings.

methods.name: br_start_inquiry
methods.description: Starts a Bluetooth inquiry process.

methods.name: valid_br_discov_param
methods.description: Validates discovery parameters.

methods.name: bt_br_discovery_start
methods.description: Starts device discovery process.

methods.name: bt_br_discovery_stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing device discovery.

methods.name: write_scan_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables scanning for devices.

methods.name: bt_br_set_connectable
methods.description: Sets the device as connectable or not.

methods.name: bt_br_set_discoverable
methods.description: Sets the device as discoverable or not.
